English: Rock Shelter
A crude refuge beneath a natural overhang, providing the barest protection for pioneers braving mountain wilds.
Cliff Hut
A sturdy wooden hut built into the cliffside, offering basic shelter and a vantage point over treacherous passes.
Stone Cabin
A small, defensive stone dwelling, built to withstand mountain storms and opportunistic raiders.
Terraced Outpost
A defensive outpost with terraced stone works, providing basic watchtowers and a small holding garrison.
Mountain Wall
A formidable curtain wall of stone, spanning ridges and sealing vulnerable approaches.
Crag Fort
A strong fortification clinging to the crags, with reinforced gates and barracks for defenders.
Peak Tower
A soaring stone tower atop the summit, commanding the valleys below and housing elite sentinels.
Citadel Perch
An imposing citadel perched atop the highest ridge, seat of mountain lords and symbol of unyielding dominion.
Mountain Bastion
A massive mountain redoubt, with layered defenses, deep cisterns, and arsenals for prolonged sieges.
Eyrie Fortress
The ultimate mountain fortress, unreachable but for the bravest, with awe-inspiring views and legendary defenses.
